_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 3: the boss and miniboss sequence ($917F-$93F1). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: A byte before the stage table `$913A`
regions.description: `00`. No reader: a lead (the table is read from `$913A + corridor`).

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): idle
regions.description: Bank 3 slot `$800F`, called from the game loop after every pass. `$70` = 0 returns: no boss. The phase `$70`: 1 = the boss command has fired (set by bank 4 command 5, or by a miniboss room's set-up), 2 = the warning, 3 = allocate the boss, 4 = the fight, 6 = after the death.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): dispatch
THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 1: corridor?
regions.description: `$30` bit 6 clear (a miniboss room) skips the score and the type.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 1 (corridor): points gained
regions.description: For the six digits: `$04B9..` := `$0170..` - `$04B9..` (decimal borrow): **the corridor-start score copy turns into the points gained so far**, which the fight then ticks down (`$92EE`).

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 1 (corridor): the stage's `$71` and the boss type
regions.description: `$71` := `$913A[corridor]` (`88` for most, `02` for 7 and 17, `00` for 21 and 22); `$72` := `$9151[corridor]` (the boss type) except in corridor 21, where command 5 gave it.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 1: the warning
THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 1: clear the counters
regions.description: `$73` = `$74` := 0 (a 16-bit frame counter).

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 1: `$71` bit 7: blow up the enemies
regions.description: `$71` bit 7 clear skips. Otherwise every object in slots 5-23 other than the spawners and those with `$0578` bit 1 (type `$29`, the formation spawner, is included) has its remembered type cleared and becomes type 8 (an explosion): **the screen is cleared of enemies** (sound `$22` if any).

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 1: stop the spawning
regions.description: `$60` |= `$71` AND 8 (bit 3: spawning stopped); `INC $70`. RUN (corridor 5): the three enemies became explosions on the first call and `$60` = `$0A`.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 2: corridor?
regions.description: `$30` bit 6 clear goes to the miniboss entrance at `$924B`.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 2: corridor 21 has no warning
regions.description: Straight to phase 3.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 2: the 16-bit counter
regions.description: `$73` / `$74` incremented every call.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 2: every 64th call
regions.description: Otherwise return.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 2: the warning tone, or the song
regions.description: While the high byte is 0, or the count is not `$0180`: sound `$43` every 64 frames. At 384 frames (`$74` = 1, `$73` = `$80`): the boss song `$9168[corridor]` (`03 03 03 06 06 03 03 06 03 06 03 16 03 06 06 16 03 16 03 16 03 06 06`). **The boss arrives 384 frames after the command** (RUN: phase 4 at call 383).

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 2: to phase 3
regions.description: `INC $70`, `JMP $92DF`.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 2, miniboss: the exits are walled up
regions.description: `$74` counts to 8, then `$73` steps: every 8th frame a sound `$43` and the next of 40 cells: the cell indices of `$92BB` (`22 23 ... 2D` along row 2, then `3E 4E ... AE` down column 14; the second 20 mirrored for the left side). A cell whose class is 0, 2, 6, 7, 8, 10, 14 or 15 (`$92CF` = 0) is rewritten as class 14 (solid) with the tile `$10` and attribute `$55` (`JSR $C117` with `$15` = `$0E`, `$16` = `$10`, `$17` = `$55`); the others (walls, class 9, and classes 1, 3, 4, 5, 11-13) are left. **The room's four openings are sealed so the player cannot leave during the fight.** RUN in the labyrinth state: 391 frames, and the class map afterwards had a row of `E` across row 2 (columns 3-12), row 11 (3-12) and column 14 (rows 4-9), the rest unchanged. After the 40 steps sound 6 (the miniboss song) and phase 3.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): miniboss: the entrance is over
regions.description: `LDA #$06 / JMP $9243`: sound 6, `INC $70`, `JMP $92DF`.

regions.name: Miniboss entrance: cell order (20 entries)
regions.description: `22 23 24 25 26 27 28 29 2A 2B 2C 2D 3E 4E 5E 6E 7E 8E 9E AE`: row/column cell indices, read forwards for the first 20 steps and mirrored for the next 20.

regions.name: Miniboss entrance: which cell classes are broken
regions.description: `00 01 00 01 01 01 00 00 00 01 00 01 01 01 00 00`: by cell class 0-15, 0 = the cell is replaced by a solid class-14 cell, 1 = left alone.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 3: make the boss
regions.description: `JSR $C027` (`$EA8C`, the highest free slot): none returns (it tries again next pass). Otherwise the slot's type := `$72`, `$75` := the slot, `INC $70`. RUN: slot 23.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 3: the type
regions.description: The slot found gets the type `$72`, `$75` := the slot, `INC $70`.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 4: the boss alive?
regions.description: The boss slot `$75` still has type `$72`: corridor only: every 64th frame the points gained tick down by one (the digit chain `$04B9..` decremented; at 0 stay at 0).

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 4: the boss is gone
regions.description: Corridor goes to `$9355`.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): miniboss dies: break the block at the centre
THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): miniboss dies: a reward box
regions.description: A free slot (the boss's own if none), type `$31` (an item box), and bank 5 `$8024` with A = `$67` (the cell, `$A33F`).

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): miniboss dies: on
THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): corridor boss dies: sound and the eraser
regions.description: Sound `$2F`; `JSR $C006` with `06 02 80`: bank 6 `$8003` (the Enemy-Eraser routine: every enemy explodes).

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): corridor boss dies: eight flashes
regions.description: For Y = 0-7: the backdrop colour `$93F2[Y]` (`0C 00 10 30 10 00 0C 0F`, through `$C0CC` = `$D33F`), sound `$23`, then 4 passes of the scroll ramp (`$E66A`) and a game-loop pass (`$FF8B`).

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): after the death
regions.description: `$70` += 2 (phase 6), `$73` := 0; **in a corridor, except corridor 21 before its last boss, the scroll target `$BA` / `$BB` := 0 (the stage stops scrolling).**

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): phase 6: 90 frames
regions.description: `$73` counts to `$5A`; then the victory music: sound `$1F` and `$1A` (`$1B` in a corridor); in corridor 21 only boss `$4D` plays it, the others just end the phase.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): corridor 21's intermediate bosses
regions.description: `$70` := 0 and return.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): victory music
regions.description: Sounds `$1F` and Y; `$70` := 0, the song-end flag `$0300` := 0.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): wait for the song to end
regions.description: In a corridor keeps the scroll running down (`JSR $C15C`); `LDY #1 / JSR $C024` is one game-loop pass; repeat until `$0300` is set (the song's end, command `$94`).

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): song over
regions.description: In a corridor `$A0` |= 1 (the stage ends: `$EB18` takes over); otherwise `JMP $C15F` (`$FFDC`: the area music starts again).

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: THE BOSS AND MINIBOSS SEQUENCE (bank 3 `$917F`, once per game-loop pass, the phase in `$70`): labyrinth: area music
regions.description: `JMP $C15F`.

regions.name: Boss death: backdrop flash colours
